name: Asaka

queries.query: Asaka Uzbekistan official cadastral map parcel geoportal Kadastr Agency
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Uzbekistan's National Geoinformation Portal, the State Urban Cadastre geoportal, the Cadastre Agency, and a government description of the national geoinformation service. The search results also identify an official Asaka district cadastral office listing.

queries.query: Asaka O'zbekiston rasmiy kadastr xaritasi geokadastr geoportal / Асака Узбекистан официальный кадастровый геопортал
queries.result: Native-language discovery returned the official National GIS portal, State Urban Cadastre geoportal, Cadastre Agency material, and the official State Cadastre Chamber page naming the Asaka district office. No ownership or personal-record lookup was attempted.

officialSources.observation: Official National Geoinformation Portal of the Uzbekistan Cadastre Agency; search result exposes coordinate and cadastral-number inputs and identifies the portal as a public map interface.
Official State Urban Cadastre geoportal; public page exposes map layers and open-data entry, but also shows an unauthenticated state.
Government information page identifies the Cadastre Agency's land, real-estate cadastre, geodesy and cartography responsibilities.
Official State Cadastre Chamber page lists an Asaka district office at Kamolot MFY, Marg'iloniy ko'chasi, 7-uy; this is local custodian evidence, not parcel coverage evidence.
Government digital-service description says the National GIS provides open real-estate-rights information through the Cadastre Agency system; no rights or owner data were requested.

registryBasis: An official Asaka district cadastral office is listed by the State Cadastre Chamber, and official national/state-urban-cadastre portals are publicly documented. This establishes a local custodian and public map/procedure route, but not citywide parcel completeness or legal-title access.
